pre_condition: file_path is a string representing a path to an extracted function file in the fm_agent/extracted_functions/ tree.
post_condition: Returns True when, in the same directory as file_path, both a readable .spec.json sidecar (a JSON file whose top-level object contains exactly the string-valued keys "signature", "pre_condition", and "post_condition") and a readable .info.json sidecar (a JSON file whose top-level object contains exactly the key "callees" mapping to an array of objects each containing exactly the string-valued keys "name", "signature", "pre_condition", and "post_condition") exist. Returns False in all other cases: either sidecar does not exist, is not a regular file, cannot be read (OS error, encoding error), contains syntactically invalid JSON, or contains a top-level JSON object that does not conform to the required schema for that sidecar type.
